name: claude-code-handoff
description: Cowork-installable port of Sting25/claude-code-handoff. Auto-snapshot session state to .claude/handoff_current.md on session exit; auto-load it on the next session start. Plus /handoff for manual invocation at clean boundaries. Snapshot logic and skill spec are by Christopher Chadwick (upstream); this port adds the plugin manifest, the hooks/hooks.json wiring, an atomic mkdir-based lock to replace flock, and a Perl JSON::PP helper to replace jq.

contributors.name: Christopher Chadwick
contributors.note: Upstream author of claude-code-handoff (https://github.com/Sting25/claude-code-handoff). Snapshot script, Stop-hook transcript appender, and /handoff skill spec are his work, used under MIT.
